record.title: Resolve the guest rootfs precondition and validate exact stock-file installation
record.intent: Test a statically justified filesystem setup separately from observer controls.
requirements: Inspect pinned guest init and mount-tool evidence before selecting a fixture setup form; distinguish boot configuration from current mount flags and preserve the failed run02 command.

Freeze a deterministic derivative of the pinned emulator ramdisk adding only an empty root-owned0755 rigol directory; verify original-entry preservation and reproducibility. In one fresh guest require live read-only rootfs and the empty unmounted mountpoint, then attempt exactly one fixed4MiB tmpfs mount at /rigol with rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec. Stop on any precondition or mount failure without remount alternatives or policy changes.

Install only the two byte-identical stock default assets at logical paths when preconditions pass; preserve absent primary and ADC paths and verify complete roundtrip hashes permissions and mount state.
Capture before and final PID enforcement process package and command-status evidence regardless of setup outcome; keep host policy and official artifacts unchanged and execute no stock application.
Preserve the exact executed subset and limitations including unobserved stock UID access; commit and push the result before another guest experiment.
acceptance: Commit and push an explicit filesystem-fixture result with reproducible evidence.
